content.text: Heroes of Might and Magic IV is a commercial collectible or trading card battle game using constructed decks, proprietary card text, and direct player conflict.

Heroes of Might and Magic IV is represented as a dedicated commercial card-game product with its own deck construction, card effects, and play environment. The source identifies it as a distinct card game rather than an expansion or ordinary playing-card variant.
2 players use the table arrangement described for Heroes of Might and Magic IV.
Constructed Heroes of Might and Magic IV decks
Constructed Heroes of Might and Magic IV decks, score area, and enough table space for play.
Each player brings a constructed deck or product-defined deck, draws an opening hand, and prepares any starting character, resource, or play area required by the rules.
